snippet.title: Armored Train Warfare Train Fest Trailer | Command the battlefield from the rails
snippet.description:
𝐀𝐑𝐌𝐎𝐑𝐄𝐃 𝐓𝐑𝐀𝐈𝐍 𝐃𝐈𝐕𝐈𝐒𝐈𝐎𝐍 · 𝐇𝐈𝐆𝐇 𝐂𝐎𝐌𝐌𝐀𝐍𝐃
𝐖𝐈𝐒𝐇𝐋𝐈𝐒𝐓 & 𝐅𝐎𝐋𝐋𝐎𝐖 𝐎𝐍 𝐒𝐓𝐄𝐀𝐌 ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4822650/Armored_Train_Warfare/
𝐉𝐎𝐈𝐍 𝐎𝐔𝐑 𝐃𝐈𝐒𝐂𝐎𝐑𝐃 ► https://discord.com/invite/VUCfHEFAcs

/ / / About This Game \ \ \
Operate a heavily armed armored train in a brutal warzone. Man turrets, manage ammunition, repair damage, upgrade your locomotive, and repel relentless enemy attacks while keeping your train moving through hostile territory.

Can your armored train survive the war?

/ / / Key Features \ \ \

► Control individual wagons or entire train composition at once, their weapons and movement
► Manage ammunition and train resources
► Repair damaged train modules during combat
► Upgrade armor, weapons, and locomotive systems
► Face tanks, artillery, aircraft, and infantry attacks
► Unlock new train cars and combat equipment
► Survive increasingly difficult missions
► Experience immersive armored warfare from the commander's seat

/ / / About The Studio \ \ \

Armored Train Warfare is developed by RETROMAGINE - an independent game studio creating original gameplay-first experiences inspired by timeless mechanics, distinctive aesthetics and memorable  games.

/ / / Hashtags \ \ \

#ArmoredTrainWarfare #traingame  #strategygames  #indiegame  #wargames 

/ / / From High Command \ \ \

The railway is no longer a supply line.
It is the battlefield.
Thank you all for following the development of Armored Train Warfare, supporting the project with wishlists, feedback and encouragement. Every new commander joining the convoy helps us move one station closer to release.

We'll see you on the rails during Steam Train Fest.

▮ 𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐕𝐎𝐘 𝐃𝐄𝐏𝐀𝐑𝐓𝐈𝐍𝐆 ▮
▮▮▮ 𝐀𝐋𝐋 𝐀𝐁𝐎𝐀𝐑𝐃 ▮▮▮

- RETROMAGINE
